title: LoopMoE: Unifying Iterative Computation with Mixture-of-Experts for Language Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2606.04438v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and looped architectures scale models along two orthogonal axes, namely parameter capacity and effective depth. However, mainstream looped architectures rely on dense backbones that couple parameter count with per-token FLOPs, which makes it impossible to isolate the effect of iterative computation under matched budgets. To this end, we present LoopMoE, a looped MoE language model that integrates sparse routing with iterative weight-shared computation through two designs. The first is IterAdaLN, which resolves weight-sharing symmetry via a modulation signal jointly conditioned on the iteration index and the per-token hidden state. The second is a capacity-balancing strategy that recovers the attention-to-FFN active parameter ratio of well-tuned non-looped references. translated_title: LoopMoE：统一迭代计算与混合专家模型用于语言建模
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.04438v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：混合专家（MoE）和循环架构分别沿两个正交维度扩展模型，即参数容量和有效深度。然而，主流循环架构依赖于密集骨干网络，这会将参数数量与每个令牌的FLOPs耦合在一起，使得在匹配预算下无法隔离迭代计算的效果。为此，我们提出了LoopMoE，一种循环MoE语言模型，通过两种设计将稀疏路由与迭代权重共享计算相结合。第一种是IterAdaLN，它通过联合条件于迭代索引和每个令牌隐藏状态的调制信号，解决了权重共享对称性问题。第二种是容量平衡策略，它恢复了调整良好的非循环参考模型中的注意力到前馈网络激活参数比。这些设计共同实现了在相同条件下，循环MoE与标准MoE之间首次严格受控的面对面评估。
tldr: LoopMoE通过迭代权重共享和稀疏路由的统一，以及IterAdaLN和容量平衡策略，首次在相同预算下实现了循环MoE与标准MoE的严格对比评估，解决了循环架构中参数与计算耦合的问题。
en_tdlr: LoopMoE unifies iterative weight-shared computation with sparse routing via IterAdaLN and capacity balancing, enabling the first strictly controlled comparison of looped MoE versus Vanilla MoE under identical budgets.
